::: {#e24738df .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


Do bigger budgets bring bigger box-office returns? @fig-budget-revenue plots each film's production budget against its worldwide revenue, both in millions of US dollars.

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
ax.set_xlabel("Budget (millions of US dollars)")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
